How it works

Follow the arrows. Hunt for bugs, reach the next milestone, and grow your team. New controls appear as you progress.

▲ adds one person or GPU to your monthly budget. ▼ removes one. Percentages show the effect of the next change: daily valids, daily findings, or harness strength / bounty value projected 30 days ahead. Hover an arrow for its metric. Rust highlights the input that needs attention. Click an output label for its explanation.

At 1× speed, one second advances one day. Progress saves in this browser. Only one tab can run the game at a time. Closing the page stops the simulation.
